balls.text: swung over the square leg boundary! Length ball at leg stump from over the wicket, shuffles to open up the square boundary behind leg and uses the pick-up shot to find it
slower short ball at middle stump, miscued pull and a very reluctant single

and there it is. Rahul doesn't look to go straight or slog too often at the death and Harshal likes bowling full. Gets down, gets behind this full ball outside off, and looks for the scoop again. Top edge goes over the keeper
scooped over the fine leg boundary. It's a low full toss at off stump, he steps into the off side, gets low and times that perfectly
low full toss, following him down leg side. Comes on nicely and flicks it to deep square
full and just outside off, lofted out towards long-off
outside edge past short third. Full and just outside off, lines it up and gives it a mighty swing
low full toss at middle stump, driven to long-on's right
bouncer at middle stump, backs away and is beaten on the upper cut as that flies past his face
length and just outside off, gets down for the ramp and miscues it. Floats in front of short fine and lands safely
in the blockhole and just outside leg, looks to whip it and cops it on the back shoe. Lbw appeal turned down
full and in the slot at leg stump but he misses on the slog, cops it on the pad
another slower short ball, this time he has enough swinging room to pull this wide of short fine leg
slower ball at middle stump, waits on that and shovels this to deep square's right
full at middle stump, driven to long-on
swung over deep midwicket! Slower ball at a length outside off, coming in with the angle from around the wicket. Clears the front leg and nails the pull
lofted over mid-off! The first boundary in six overs. It's a length ball outside off from around the wicket. The fielder is in the circle and he punches on the up to clear him
low full toss at leg stump, flicked to deep midwicket's left
would've been out with a direct hit. Full and just outside off, driven straight to Patidar at extra cover with good timing. Was never going to complete the run
full slower ball outside off, shapes to drive, adjusts to push towards point
bouncer slants down leg side as he ducks, not called wide
full slower ball outside off, driven to long-off
slower ball, short of a length outside off. Cut to sweeper's left
offcutter at a length on off stump, gets forward and flicks into the leg side
full at off stump, drilled along the floor to long-on
length at off stump, punched to long-off
length and into leg stump, gets forward and flicks to long-on's right
length and sliding across off stump, miscued sweep to deep midwicket
top edge lands safely in the leg side. Length at leg stump, gets down for the lap sweep. AB chases to his left but that's not even half a chance
short and wide outside off, punched to sweeper's left
length and turning into leg stump, whipped to deep midwicket off the back foot
length and turning into off stump, blocked on the front foot
another googly and this time it meets off stump! Short of a length just outside off, looks to cut that. Caught on the front foot, big gap between bat and leg.
appeal for lbw as he slips in another googly. At length on middle stump, he got forward and looked to block it. Proper deception that from Chahal
googly, full at middle stump, leans in and flicks to midwicket
length at middle stump, punched off the back foot to long-on

miscued pull and taken at deep backward square! Short of a length and pushed through quicker at leg stump. Wants to send this over square leg, but has gotten under it and hauled it upwards. It's the long side of the ground too. Taken easily
length at middle stump, patted back to the bowler
length outside off, steps out and is beaten in flight. Has to reach out and drive to sweeper
short of a length outside off, punched to sweeper off the back foot
length at leg stump, punched into the leg side off the back foot
length at leg stump, dropped into the leg side with soft hands
short of a length just outside off, punched to sweeper cover off the back foot
full at middle stump, backs away and drives to long-off
length at off stump, defended into the covers
just manages to get bat on this. Full at middle stump and he was down early for the sweep. Too early. Had to watch it on and jam it out into the leg side
length and sliding on at off stump, blocked on the front foot
length at off stump, punched to long-off on the back foot
length at leg stump, punched to long-on with the angle
length at middle stump, shuffles and flicks to deep square
short of a length just outside off, punched to backward point

fended straight to backward point and another duck for Pooran! Fourth of the season. Short ball into off stump. He wants to ride the bounce and get that to third man but he's opened the face too soon and it's popped up for an easy catch
short ball at middle stump, hooks on the bounce to fine leg and is annoyed with himself. But that shot has also brought up his fifty
crunched over extra cover. Floaty overpitched ball outside off, gets a stride in and goes clean with this lofted drive
offcutter at a length outside off, punched to extra cover on the up
offcutter, short of a length and turning down leg. Beaten on the glance
full and just outside off, gets forward and pushes back to the bowler

he's got him and he's delighted! Sams with a sharp, steep bouncer from a middle stump line. Slanted in at the front shoulder and he's surprised and looks to swish this, out of position and eyes off. Gets a glove and AB takes that to his right
short of a length just outside off, punched to sweeper off the back foot
lofted into the RCB dug out. Full slower ball just outside off, mid-off is in and he uses that freedom to send this drive in the air
slower ball at a length on leg stump, jabbed to deep midwicket
slower bouncer, dug in too short and left alone outside off
length at off stump, defended into the covers
slower bouncer at off stump, lines it up and hooks along the ground to deep square
slower ball at a length on leg stump, gets forward and jabs through midwicket
full and down leg side, looks to flick and gets something on that. Harshal appeals but that isn't taken cleanly by the keeper anyway
full and into the pads, stands tall and tickles that fine of the short fine leg fielder
beaten. Slammed into a length just outside off, and straightens as Gayle pushes at it
clears the front leg and then clears deep midwicket! Lobbed up at a length on leg stump, gets into position quickly and nails this slog sweep
oh well adjusted. Short of a length at middle stump, he exposes the stumps and had to wait a lot. That stayed low and so did he, and then chopped this wide of short third
slower again, length and turning into leg stump. Swept on the up to deep square
length, slow and turning in from off stump. Patted back down the pitch
length at off stump, punched very late into the covers with no feet movement
length and turning into leg stump, gets deep in the crease and tucks it through square leg
length and into leg stump, clipped to deep square
length outside off, leans into a drive to sweeper cover
offcutter at a length and turning into off stump, pushed back down the pitch
stays low and skids under the bat. Length ball, a cutter and wide outside off. Plants the front leg forward to try and slam through extra cover
slashed wide of this man. Short of a length and wide outside off, on the front foot and chopping from under it. Bounces just short of the boundary
that grips and rises. Offcutter at a length outside off, cuts in and jumps past the outside edge as he shapes to drive on the up
struck firmly in the direction of the sightscreen! Tossed up outside off again and he uses his reach to pummel this
length at the stumps, pushed down the pitch
length at middle and off, gets low and paddles this to deep square's left
length at off stump, blocked on the front foot
drilled over the non-striker! Tossed right up outside off and he gets to the pitch and hits it flat, about chest height
full on leg stump, driven along the floor to long-on
patted wide of mid-off! Five fours off the last over of the powerplay. Slower ball, short and very wide outside off. Stands upright and punches this into the ground and into the gap
misses out! A full toss at off stump seems to have caught him off guard. Mistimed drive to extra cover
doesn't matter if you have long-on! Another driving ball at middle stump, gets half a stride out and slams this over the bowler, to long-on's right
lofted over mid-on! This is pretty friendly bowling from Jamieson. Overpitched at a middle and off line and he lifts this off the low part of the bat, one bounce and over the boundary
slapped wide of mid-on! Short of a length and a lot of width again. Gets forward and pulls it between midwicket and mid-on
gives him width and is punished. Length and nice landing outside off. Gets forward and slices this over mid-off
length at off stump, defended into the covers with soft hands
full outside off, leans in and flicks to mid-on's right
another good-looking boundary. Overpitched at middle stump, stands tall, half a stride into this and a n on-drive to beat the fielder to his left
looks to go yorker first up, ends up a full toss at middle stump. Flicked to midwicket's left
length and just outside off, leans in and drives on the up to sweeper's left
length and into middle stump, defended down the pitch
short of a length at leg stump, patted to deep square off the back foot
length at leg stump, pushed to midwicket off the front foot
length and fired down leg side, can't get the flick away
legcutter, short of a length at off stump. Defended into the off side

taken easily at extra cover. Short of a length outside off, backs into the leg side to try and make room. Looked initially like he wanted to chop that over the off side, but on close inspection it's a pull shot gone wrong. Gets big on him and he ends up slicing it
short of a length at off stump, opens the face and runs it straight to short third
length and just outside off, leans in and drives elegantly with a big stride. Kohli dives to the right at extra and stops that from getting to the boundary
slower ball, short of a length and wide. Winds up and looks to slap this through the off side. Beaten by the variation. It trickles into the covers off the toe-end
lofted straight over the bowler! Full and just outside off, half a stride out and full intent to send this flying. Lands a yard before the boundary padding and bounces over
slower ball at a length on off stump, gets forward and blocks
short of a length just outside off, punched to sweeper's left
length and just outside off, punched into the covers on the rise
short of a length and skidding on low to beat the bat as he cuts
short of a length and slanted into the body, waits on that and hauls it wide of mid-on
low full toss at the stumps, patted straight to mid-on
length and into leg stump, leans in and jabs to midwicket
classy. Short of a length ball at off stump, 143.9kph, springs onto the front foot and is absolutely still and upright as he pulls this over the straight midwicket boundary
short and into the body as he looks to make room by walking down leg. Forced to pat into the covers
length and slanted down leg side, looks to glance that and there's a sound of some sort. Appeal for catch is turned down
length and just outside off, tentative push to gully
short and wide outside off, cut firmly to sweeper cover
length and just outside off, watchfully driven to extra cover
length and just outside off, punches on the up towards mid-off
full and slanted across off stump, driven on the up to mid-off
curve inwards again as he shapes for the punch on the up through the covers. Good length and hooping in sharply
inswinging yorker to start. Dips back in from outside off and forces him to get the front leg out of the way and keep this out
yorker across the corridor, looks to drive and misses
yorker at leg stump, jammed down to long-on

Bishnoi's taken another stunner! Wow! He's really enjoying fielding in the deep this season! Low full toss at off stump, backs away and lofts this to long-off's right. Bishnoi tracks it and then lunges forward and to his right to grab this very close to the turf
short of a length and across middle stump, backs away and looks to pull, gets a top edge over short third

ouch. That is struck powerfully back at the bowler. Looks like it's gone straight into his right knee. Length ball just outside off and he's clubbed it right back. He was jumping to try and evade that but it was too high for him to manage it. Hops into the off side and goes to floor. Has a smile on his face but  that is a definite swelling and a bruise. He's limping off the field
that is massive! Dropped short outside off and coming on nicely as he backs into the leg side and pulls wholeheartedly
pumped over the bowler. Some poor lengths for the 19th over from Jordan. This is just outside off and in the slot. He backs away and muscles this straight
short of a length at middle stump, backs away and looks to slap again, thick inside edge to long-on
short and just outside off, backs away and slashes, but is beaten as that gets big on him
length and at leg stump, drilled down to long-on
clubbed to sweeper's right this time. Full and just outside off, backs into the leg side again and crunches this sweetly on the half-volley
expertly sliced over point. Full and into off stump, exposes the stumps and meets this nicely with an open face
length and wide outside off,  toe-ended slash out to sweeper cover
low full toss at off stump, pats it over extra cover. Bishnoi runs a long way to his left from long-off and slides to keep that in

Appeal for lbw as he looks to ramp this. Gayle is standing in for Rahul and he takes the review. He's around the wicket but this yorker is at the stumps and hits him in front of off stump. Might be missing off...he had walked a long way across. Yes it is missing off
drilled past the umpire. It's overpitched and just outside off, he clears the front foot and cracks this firmly
low full toss at off stump, backs away and slices to sweeper
just clears long-off. Full and just outside off, backs away and goes inside-out with some nice timing
yorker outside off, clears the front leg and misses on the slog
full and just outside off, looks to drive through the off side, gets an inside edge to fine leg's left
full and just outside off, clears the front leg and drives to mid-off
low full toss at leg stump, punched to long-on's right
short at off stump, backs away and drops it into the off side with soft hands
yorker length at leg stump, squeezed down to fine leg
inside edge rolls into the back leg. Length ball outside off, gets forward to defend and gets lucky
googly, short of a length outside off and spinning into middle. Looks to swipe over that, angled bat, and the stumps are split
taken at deep midwicket! Harpreet is there too. Length ball sliding across the corridor, fetches it with a slog sweep but is taken comfortably inside the line
googly, length and wide outside off. Backs away and looks to drill over extra. Off the inside half to long-off
short of a length just outside off, backs away and cuts to extra cover's left. A misfield from Harpreet and sweeper has to clean up
full at off stump, flicked down to long-on
short of a length just outside off, punched on the rise to extra cover
short of a length just outside off, chopped straight to backward point

holes out to long-on and Patidar's innings ends just as inelegantly as it has looked all evening. Full and into middle stump, clears the front leg and looks to slog. His top hand slips off the handle, his body's facing midwicket, his bat held high in the right hand. Not a great night for him. Pooran comes in from the boundary and holds on
low full toss down leg side, can't get bat on that
short of a length and into leg stump, looks to flick and cops that on the thigh

sneaks through from under third man's dive. Bishnoi dives forward for the catch and it trickles off him into the boundary. Short of a length ball outside off, has a pull at that and ends up slicing it. Bishnoi did well to react that quickly
full and into middle stump, slugged out to deep midwicket
nearly finds long-off who is very straight. Full and just outside off, clears the front leg and drives it flat and over the non-striker. Just short of Pooran
dropped short at middle stump, stays upright and pumps this pull shot over long-on
length at middle stump, clears the front leg and swipes that to long-on's right
length outside off, looks for the slog sweep, gets an inside edge to short fine
short of a length outside off, chopped to point
length and pushed across off stump, driven on the up to long-off
length at leg stump, flicked to midwicket
full and in at middle stump, mistimed haul into the leg side off the inside edge
short of a length at off stump, punched to sweeper off the back foot
length at off stump, blocked down the pitch
length at middle stump, flicked to midwicket

he's got AB too! This is a fairytale for Harpreet. Short of a length and pushed through at off stump, sticks in the pitch. AB clears the front leg and looks to punch it on the rise through the covers. Ends up chipping it straight to Rahul at extra cover
short of a length at off stump, punched to sweeper cover
slider at a length, down leg side. Simran dives to his left to get hands on that. Deflected towards short fine
googly, short and into leg stump, pulled to deep square on the bounce
short of a length and sliding on outside off, chopped off the under edge into the covers
googly at a length outside off, steps out for the slog and gets a thick inside edge to deep square
googly, wide outside off. Whipped on the rise towards long-off
full and just outside off, mistimed slog along the ground to long-on
turn and bounce to beat the cut and a double-wicket maiden is sealed in an over where only some of the biggest stars of the game batted. Short of a length outside off and rising past the bat
length at off stump, driven back to the bowler
short of a length just outside off, under-edge on the punch and it ends up at extra cover
anxious push into the off side. Length and threatening to turn away and AB pats it into the covers on the rise

oh Harpreet you ripper! I think he's spun it from middle, beaten Maxwell's whip into the leg side and hit the top of off. For some reason they're sending that upstairs...yeah it's dead-on. He's squared him up to hit the top of off. Maxwell didn't know what happened. Neither did the umpires, it appears. But the evidence is there - Harpreet has pitched this at a length on middle stump and turned it past Maxwell to clean him up

that stays low and slides into leg stump. Short of a length at middle stump, he steps out and looks to turn that through midwicket. That slides on low and is past him. He looks at the pitch in surprise, Harpreet has the most subdued celebration with his arm raised. What a wicket to get
length outside off, leans in and punches to extra cover
length at off stump, steps out and gets an inside edge onto pad as he looks to whip
length at middle, hauled to long-on

googly turns past leg stump as he looks to slog this. In fact, that might have nicked the leg stump! We'll have to watch that closer. Simran appeals on instinct as he takes this down leg side. Definitely hit the outside of the stump. No light though, Ultra Edgge confirms it did. That spun in from a length at middle stump
short of a length and squeezed out to deep backward square off the back foot

this has potential for a freak dismissal. Length at middle stump, steps out to drill straight, gets an inside edge onto boot that floats up for Simran, the keeper, who takes the ball. They're checking to see if that pitched before hitting the boot. Yes it did. The back leg and popped up, nice reflexes from the keeper
short of a length at middle stump, pulled to long-on's right off the front foot
length and into the pads, looks to swipe that over square leg, cops it on the pad
short of a length and sliding into the corridor, mistimed punch to extra cover's right
length and down leg side, looks for the whip behind square, gets it over the keeper off the front pad. Gayle gives chase
slowed down at a length on middle stump, looks to stab through cover but is too eager. Pushed down the pitch in the end
oh trademark. Length ball pushed through at middle stump, steps out and drives on the rise to the extra cover boundary
length and just outside off, gets forward and jabs that to point's left
short of a length at leg stump, deflected to fine leg's right off the thigh
short of a length and into the corridor, beaten on the under-edge again as he looks to cut

oh that's poor from Brar at point. Short of a length just outside off, steps out and looks to punch. Mistimes it to point. The batsmen have a slight hesitation about the run and you can hear the Punjab fielders shouting at Brar not to throw. He does at the non-strikers and they pinch a run
short of a length and just outside off, neat punch into the turf, point rises two-handed and tips it over before recovering to field
short of a length and into the corridor, looks for the cut and is beaten on the inside edge
mix-up but Kohli's back in time. Length outside off, steps out and closes the face, gets a leading edge to extra cover's left and is sent back
short of a length at leg stump, whipped to deep midwicket
short of  a length at middle stump, punched to deep midwicket

short of a length at middle stump, mistimed pull into vacant midwicket. Keeper gives chase and is off the stumps. Deep midwicket does well to put a one bounce throw back in to keep them to one, but Shahrukh, running in from point, can't gather that cleanly as it comes at pace
quicker and full at middle stump, pushed back to the bowler
steps out and launches straight! Length at middle stump, quickly down the pitch to meet this on the bounce and holds his shape to send that flying
short of a length and into leg stump, whipped to deep midwicket off the back foot
length and into leg stump, flicked to deep midwicket's left
short of a length and into leg stump, hurried glance to short fine's left
length and sliding into the pads as he gets forward for the flick outside leg stump
short of a length and sliding onto leg stump, cops that on the pad as he looks to glance
length and sliding onto leg stump, whipped straight to square leg
short of a length at leg stump, gets back and turns it to towards deep square
length and slanted in at middle stump, leans in and flicks this on the rise, with so much elegance. Fully in control, fully balanced, and clipped wide of mid-on with his weight going into that
length and into leg stump, shuffles and flicks with great timing to find deep square
length and just outside off, 144.5kph, gets forward and punches towards mid-on
short of a length at off stump, mistimed whip to square leg's right and once again some confusion about the running. Dot-balls getting to RCB
short of a length just outside off, a neat looking punch to cover's left. He fumbles and they think of a run. Take a few strides and decide against it
short of a length and tight at middle stump, hurriedly jabbed towards mid-on
short at middle stump, pulled firmly and on the bonce to deep backward square
short of a length at off stump, looks to flick and gets an inside edge onto his back leg
length and into leg stump, looks to flick and cops that on the pad
short of a length just outside off, opens the face and deflects to third man
short of a length at leg stump, deflected to fine leg off the back foot
length outside off, looks to drive on the up and gets that off the inside half into the leg side
length at middle stump, looks to flick and cops that on the thigh guard. Patidar wants a run but is sent back. Dives as the throw from the off side comes in
length at leg stump, upright as he flicks to fine leg's left

makes a mockery of off stump! What. A. Sight. Length and fired in at an off stump line, 145.7kph. Padikkal backs into the leg side as he steps out, exposes the stumps and looks to slam the over the infield. It's wayyy too quick for that. Off stump is sent a long way into the leg side, in fine leg's direction
carved over point. Full and wide outside off, throws his hands at that and hopes. There's 144kph worth of pace on that ball and that clears the rope
length at off stump, shuffles and flicks to deep square
offcutter at a length on leg stump, flicked to square leg
short of a length and across the corridor, beaten on the late cut
length outside off, driven off the inside half to mid-on
slower short one at middle stump, looks to pull and cops that just under the right elbow
length at off stump, patted into the leg side on the up
oh sweeet! Gosh that looked so good. Length ball at off stump, he steps out and drills this over the umpire's head. Such quick hands
full and just outside off, jabbed to mid-off's right off the front foot to steal the single
length and at leg stump, stands tall and whips this to the fine leg boundary
oh that looks plumb but the lbw appeal is turned down because he has an inside edge on it. Full and into off stump, wants to whip him over square leg and can't get it away
full and just outside off, driven to mid-off's left
beaten. Length and just outside off, 144.7kph, beaten on the swish on the rise
length and in at off stump, 144kph, pushed towards mid-on
